## Overview of course assignments

Course work is organized into four assignment groups. Detailed instructions, rubrics, submission procedures, and current deadlines are available on [Canvas](https://canvas.howard.edu/courses/70108){target="_blank"}.

| Assignment group                 |  Points |
|----------------------------------|--------:|
| Archival research                |      10 |
| Personal philosophy of education |      10 |
| Quizzes                          |      20 |
| Midterm examination              |      30 |
| Supreme Court trial reenactments |      30 |
| **Total**                        | **100** |
